ranked.headline: Linking cell morphology, histology and imaging to molecular states within intact tissue
ranked.summary: Spatially resolved, cell-level methods now connect histology, multiplex imaging and cell shape descriptors to molecular and tissue-level organisation.

ranked.headline: Open software for tandem repeat, non-coding variant, and colocalisation genomics analysis
ranked.summary: Population-scale sequencing and biobank data increasingly require fast, reusable tools for repeat genotyping, variant-to-gene mapping, and colocalisation.

ranked.headline: Evaluation protocol design shapes reported performance of biomolecular prediction models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and published studies show benchmark design, leakage and taxonomic shortcuts can change which biomolecular predictors appear best.

ranked.headline: Drug response models gaining calibrated uncertainty and leakage-aware benchmarking
ranked.summary: Predictive models of drug and perturbation response are being judged on calibration, leakage control, and held-out benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Generative models coupling binder design to structure, epitope, and kinetic objectives
ranked.summary: Structure-aware generative models now target explicit epitope, structural, and kinetic objectives across nanobodies, peptides, antibodies, and TCRs.

ranked.headline: Population variation and chromosome-scale genomes resolve adaptive genetic architecture
ranked.summary: Reference-quality genomes and variant panels now enable explicit tests of adaptation and prediction across plants, amphibians, primates, and human populations.

ranked.headline: Graph and sequence models predict antimicrobial, toxicity, and mechanistic readouts
ranked.summary: Prediction of combination effects and mechanistic readouts is moving into the modeling stage rather than remaining endpoint-only scoring.

ranked.headline: Simulations map stage-resolved conformational transitions in signalling proteins
ranked.summary: MD, Markov state modelling and multi-scale simulations resolve pathway and stage dependence in MLKL, NLRP3, TDP-43 and UCH-L1 conformational behaviour.

ranked.headline: Single-cell readouts used for haplotype-resolved variant and allele inference
ranked.summary: Single-cell long-read and chromatin data now support de novo haplotype and somatic variant calls benchmarked against long-read ground truth.

ranked.headline: New algorithms extract regulatory and genome-architecture features from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Recent methods extend short-read and cfDNA sequencing to centromere architecture, methylation haplotypes, and nucleosome occupancy inference.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and open tools refine peptide identification and quantification in MS
ranked.summary: Consensus and long-gradient reference labels now underpin new machine learning approaches to peptide identification.

ranked.headline: Structured generative models map multimodal neuroimaging to voxel and network readouts
ranked.summary: Cross-tracer tau PET harmonization and voxel-level pseudo-timelines of Alzheimer's change expose disease heterogeneity computationally.

ranked.headline: Generative and scoring models tied to sequence-level objectives in RNA, DNA and protein
ranked.summary: Sequence generation coupled to structure prediction and fitness scoring now spans RNA, nucleic acid and protein design.

ranked.headline: Structured mixed and neural models extend genomic prediction and association testing
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications add covariate-aware, longitudinal and high-dimensional methods for genomic and omics association and prediction.

ranked.headline: Phylogeny-constrained orthogroup inference for pan-gene families in complex genomes
ranked.summary: Pan-gene family analysis in complex genomes is shifting toward phylogeny-aware orthogroup inference and curated annotation resources.

ranked.headline: Plasma proteomics infers cell-type aging and multi-disease risk in human cohorts
ranked.summary: Plasma proteomic profiles now yield cell-type biological age estimates and platform-portable health archetypes tied to disease and mortality.

ranked.headline: Scoring cell type annotations without ground truth across single-cell and spatial omics
ranked.summary: Preprints in this set pair annotation evaluation without ground truth with spatial multi-omics integration and foundation-model data infrastructure.

ranked.headline: Deep models encode priors and align modalities for transcriptomic prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair foundation models and graph or contrastive encoders with transcriptomic, proteomic, and pathology data.

ranked.headline: Standardized interfaces for sequence models, microscopy I/O, omics and taxonomy
ranked.summary: Reuse of biological data increasingly depends on machine-usable standards, policy-driven I/O and agent-operable workflows.

ranked.headline: Grounding and interpretability constrain ML outputs in biomarker and target discovery
ranked.summary: Recent studies test whether ML predictions in biomarker and target discovery can be tied to explicit evidence in clinical and genetic datasets.

ranked.headline: Explicit probabilistic structure is being imposed on genomic inference problems
ranked.summary: Copy-number, mutational signature, and miRNA target analyses now report posterior uncertainty within single probabilistic frameworks.

ranked.headline: New genomics tools pair runtime speedups with reproducible, workflow-based delivery
ranked.summary: Recent tools target both runtime bottlenecks and reproducible, standardized outputs across sequencing and variant analysis.

ranked.headline: Genomic inference links recombination, resistance evolution, and virulence variation
ranked.summary: Large-scale genome datasets now enable quantitative inference of recombination, horizontal transfer, and resistance trajectories across pathogens.

ranked.headline: Software for spatial CRISPR screening and single-cell drug sensitivity inference
ranked.summary: Perturbation and drug-response readouts are moving into intact tissue and single-cell resolution, demanding new analysis tools.

ranked.headline: Conserved domains and sequence patterns trace eukaryotic and extremophile genome evolution
ranked.summary: Recent work separates conserved from lineage-specific DNA and regulatory features across extremophiles, nucleosomes and eukaryotic transcription factors.

ranked.headline: Culture-independent recovery of high-quality microbial genomes from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Long-read single-cell assembly, SRA-scale pipelines and population-scale host association now extend genome-resolved metagenomics.

ranked.headline: LLM agents gain reliability from versioned tools and separable planning and recovery tests
ranked.summary: Three new preprints test LLM agents on peptide design, pharmacogenomic mapping, and bioinformatics planning using checkable, executed components.

ranked.headline: Genome resources link horizontal transfer and P450 detoxification in non-model taxa
ranked.summary: Sequence resources for non-model taxa now address specific biology: horizontal gene transfer, gene family annotation, and proposed P450 detoxification.

ranked.headline: Metal parameterization in MD reveals dynamics of clinical PA endonuclease mutants
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published framework extend structure-based computation toward protein design, aggregation, and clinical variant interpretation.

ranked.headline: Coupling lineage tree topology to cell fate and state-transition inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a commentary couple lineage structure to fate decisions, moving tree inference beyond standalone reconstruction.

ranked.headline: Curvature-derived geometric features are being added to protein-ligand affinity models
ranked.summary: Two June 2026 preprints add curvature-derived encodings to affinity models, while a published DTA model fuses pocket context.

ranked.headline: Computational models predict viral host targets, phenotypes, and variant emergence
ranked.summary: Host-virus interaction networks and metabolic models are being used to infer viral phenotypes and anticipate variants before they emerge.

ranked.headline: Models link chromatin accessibility to expression and correct spatial transcript leakage
ranked.summary: Explainable AI names H3K18ac as an enhancer mark while multiomic and spatial methods refine regulatory inference.

ranked.headline: Tractable models expose parameters governing neural oscillation and synchrony
ranked.summary: Recent models tie ion channel kinetics and spatial connectivity to network-level function, from voltage traces to locomotor circuits.

ranked.headline: Simulation links membrane and ligand dynamics to experimental observables
ranked.summary: Recent preprints tie simulated membrane and ligand dynamics to cryo-EM density and viral assembly geometry.

ranked.headline: Atomic model building and validation directly against cryo-EM density maps
ranked.summary: Medium- to low-resolution and single-particle maps need geometric priors and residue-level validation to yield trustworthy atomic models.

ranked.headline: Graphical models and weighted networks extend gene regulatory and protein complex maps
ranked.summary: Recent methods extend network inference to gene regulatory expansion, error-corrected expression networks, and overlapping protein complex mining.

ranked.headline: Energetic-entropic PMF splitting and enhanced-sampling MD probe protein dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a 2026 benchmark probe whether enhanced-sampling and coarse-grained simulations yield correct protein conformational ensembles.

ranked.headline: Agent-based and Bayesian simulators resolve MAPK/ERK pathway dynamics and drug responses
ranked.summary: GPU agent-based and dynamic Bayesian models now simulate MAPK/ERK pathway perturbations and rank known-drug combinations in silico.

ranked.headline: Multimodal single-cell models extend to aging, spatial mapping and organ-wide atlases
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair neural integration and generative models with spatial, chromatin and aging single-cell data across organs and disease.
